title: "No executable found" from ros2 run and "not found on the libexec directory" for ament_python: entry_points, setup.cfg and --symlink-install, measured
excerpt: Where ros2 run looks for a Python node, and what put it elsewhere: a missing or misnamed entry point, a missing setup.cfg that sends the script to bin/, unsourced shells, and --symlink-install with newer setuptools. Measured with colcon on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
